zoe_marketing: Quick sync 12h to go. Two things: docs anchor mismatch reported and webinar RSVP routing needs embedding/dedicated tagging. Can we confirm?

ash_eng: I noticed the docs anchor name changed after the last patch. I'll push a tiny docs redirect so /docs/serving/rollouts#pin -> /docs/serving/rollouts#pin-models. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/5602

devon_prod: Webinar page is set: https://redwood.ai/events/scale-deploy. I added a checkbox "Interested in Dedicated" and "Interested in Embeddings"; those map to lead tags.

tina_docs: Confirmed redirect + added brief CLI example and screenshot:```redwoodctl pin --model v2.8.0``` Assets at /assets/pin-v2.8.png

zoe_marketing: Great. For the social blurb: one sentence on cost gains, one line CTA to register, link to changelog. Keep technical caveat only in changelog link.

ash_eng: Changelog ready with anchors: #changes, #migration-dedicated, #known-issues. Tagging the migration anchor for deep link.

ops-bot: Canary queued: release/v2.8.0 -> start 2026-04-02T09:30:00-07:00. Notifications to #deploys.

devon_prod: Publish plan 1: publish once canary hits 50% healthy. I'll be on deck to flip. Sales ops will get the pre-release note when canary is green.

zoe_marketing: Who can export the small perf table (median, p95, p99) for the post? Need CSV.

ash_eng: Uploading perf.csv in 15m. Will include hardware/testbed note.

zoe_marketing: Perfect. No embargo. Let's keep copy light and link to full benchmarks. Ping here at 09:45 PT for final go/no-go. :rocket:
